title: Build independent single-step quality and work-budget oracles
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Implement the new profile's independent public-API test cases and small-scene numerical/candidate oracles before changing solver equations. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Translate every F8-00 limit into a named assertion over fixed workloads and input envelopes; include all advertised domains/modes and mixed three-plus-family cases.
Test cold starts, long runs, impacts/rotation, stiff systems, mass ratios, containment, sources/removals, replacement, overflow and recovery; include failing negative controls.
Keep old-profile regression/quality results separate; baseline failures at one 1/60 step are recorded rather than weakening thresholds.
Specify dispatch/iteration/index-update and timing assertions in per-tick units, with deterministic mock-clock tests where hardware timing is not applicable.
evidence: python3 conformance/v1/realtime_oracle.py --check-contract: PASS (243 named limits, 49 advertised capability cases, 14 fixed workloads, 5 runtime adapters)
